childEvidence.fact: The child is currently nine years old.
She asked to continue difficult riddles and later requested harder riddles.
She noticed repeated riddles and questioned faulty riddle logic.
When stuck on a multi-step logic problem, she requested hints and continued after scaffolding.
Small-sample child feedback favored clear examples, visible color, and an available hint.
